concepts.title: The Bar Remembers Her
concepts.idea: A restrained solo performance where the empty bar behaves like memory around her.
concepts.setting: approved Finnish bar, winter window, Burmese craft inserts
concepts.performance: mature, elegant, emotionally pressurized, no karaoke staging
concepts.camera: slow lateral tracks, profile coverage, wide face-safe frames
concepts.movement: grounded side-travel, below-shoulder arms, no random dance vocabulary
concepts.edit_rhythm: quiet verses, stronger chorus object/face alternation
risks: AI frames require optional model approval

concepts.title: Winter Window, Crimson Dress
concepts.idea: A colder, more graphic version built around negative space and the window as emotional pressure.
concepts.setting: bar stage reduced to silhouettes and window reflections
concepts.camera: asymmetric frames with left-side negative space
concepts.movement: minimal walking, turns and object touch only
risks: may need more object insert coverage

concepts.title: Objects After Love
concepts.idea: The song is carried by bar objects, lacquer/craft inserts and withheld performance.
concepts.setting: bar details, empty glass, microphone only at ending
concepts.performance: few direct face moments, mostly profile and silhouette
concepts.movement: object actions and small grounded steps
concepts.edit_rhythm: object cutaways cover low-confidence lyric regions
